context_requirements: Expression of LRRK2 or LRRK2 pathway components
Presence of a constitutively active or ligand-stimulated LRRK2 signaling context
Cell type with LRRK2-dependent transcriptional output (e.g., immune or neuronal cells)
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of LRRK2-dependent gene signatures or pathway markers after treatment
Shared transcriptional response across multiple cell lines that correlates with LRRK2 inhibition
